parameters.apprise_url_plus: sns://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.access_key_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.secret_access_key_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.region_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.targets_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-sns` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Amazon SNS destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional Amazon SNS destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Amazon SNS destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

access_key_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Amazon SNS access key id

region_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Amazon SNS region

secret_access_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Amazon SNS secret access key

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Amazon SNS targets
